term: no self-contained borrowing of actual concrete existence
definition: The existing Escape cut principle holds for the recorded actual-concrete existential-grounding graph, with intrinsic set to its sources and every roster member active: each nonempty set contains a source or contains the effect of an admitted supplier whose whole contributor set lies outside it. This is a substantive no-self-contained-borrowing premise, not implied by actual existence, local coherence, or supplying merely some member.
note: Specific application of the existing Escape predicate and recorded graph. The actual-concrete roster supplies existing bearers; supplier records have nonempty contributors. For the entire nonempty roster the escaping-supplier horn is impossible, yielding a source. The application to real existential grounding remains OPEN and is not justified by this mathematical derivation. See the leading cumulative argument in docs/notes/ultimate-adequacy-integration-735.md.
